Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL on culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
